title: CmdPal: Add a Performance Monitor Overview card and dock band

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream inherited null-returning method and explicit saved-pin consumers establish failed resolution. UI execution is not claimed.

proposed_comments.body:
**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/ext/Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.PerformanceMonitor/PerformanceMonitorCommandsProvider.cs` (`GetCommandItem`), `PerformanceWidgetsPage.cs` (`_overviewItem`), and `SystemOverviewWidgetPage.cs` (`Id`).

**Problem:** The new Overview list item has command ID `com.microsoft.cmdpal.overview_widget`, but the provider does not override `GetCommandItem`; the toolkit implementation returns `null`. CmdPal detects `ICommandProvider4` and offers the item's pin commands, then calls `GetCommandItem` when loading saved home pins. Dock pin loading also falls back to that method because this ID is neither the provider's top-level command nor its separately registered `com.microsoft.cmdpal.performanceWidget.overview` band. The saved Overview item therefore cannot be resolved. This source path exists on this PR's head, independently of the mega-merge branch.

**Why it matters:** A user can pin Overview but cannot have that saved item restored on the home page or dock. Registering the separate Overview band alone does not resolve the Overview content-page ID.

**Suggested change:**
1. Override `GetCommandItem` in the Performance Monitor provider to resolve `com.microsoft.cmdpal.overview_widget` to its existing Overview command item, using the provider's current state lock and ownership. Do not create another metric-page set during lookup.
2. Keep the returned command ID equal to the requested ID, return `null` for unknown IDs, and preserve the separate Overview band's ID and idle-sampling behavior.
3. Add provider lookup coverage for the Overview ID and an unknown ID, then verify pinning Overview to home and dock survives a command reload and app restart.

**Verification:** Exact-head source tracing confirms the inherited null lookup, the two different IDs, and the saved-pin consumers. The existing Overview list/band tests do not exercise this lookup. The pinning interaction and replacement implementation have not been executed; the new tests and UI checks above are acceptance criteria.
proposed_comments.title: Resolve saved Overview pins through the provider
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction adds the missing provider lookup override outside the changed ranges; proof spans the unchanged toolkit and host pin-resolution consumers. No apply-ready replacement is claimed.
